_about: Areas users can clip data to before receiving it. Shared by the ArcGIS Pro toolbox and the Python/R helpers. Boundaries come from the listed services; 'fallback' is a copy shipped with this repo or kept on the internal network for offline use.

areas.label: California (state border)
areas.notes: Land boundary only; coastal waters are outside it. Offer the 'buffer' option for coastal and marine work.

areas.label: California by watersheds (state plus every HUC12 that crosses into it)

source.method: Union of California and all WBD HUC12 polygons that intersect it (see SDriveInventory/CaliforniaAOI.py)

areas.notes: 439,570 km2; 4,472 HUC12s in 140 HUC8s; 57 HUC8s reach into NV, OR, AZ, Mexico or offshore. Default area for national datasets.

areas.label: County

source.provider: California Department of Technology (CDT), 'California County Boundaries and Identifiers': the state's authoritative county layer (CAL FIRE's is derived from it)

with_coastal_buffers.notes: 81 features: counties extended over coastal water (OFFSHORE field). Good default for coastal and marine data.

alternatives.provider: US Census TIGERweb (federal, matches Census geography)

areas.notes: 58 counties, edited 2026-09 (checked 2026-09-30). CDT also publishes city boundaries and overlapping city/county layers with the same identifiers.

areas.label: Southern California
areas.notes: Common 10-county definition. SCCWRP may prefer a coastal-watershed definition (e.g. the SMC region, Ventura to San Diego); see open questions in DESIGN.md.

areas.label: Northern California
areas.notes: Southern + Central + Northern = all 58 counties, each exactly once.

areas.label: HUC watershed (choose level 2 to 12, then one or more units)

levels_in_california.14: partial (114 units in the USGS service, none in our 2025 national WBD copy)

areas.notes: Layer ids checked 2026-09-30 (1 = HU2 ... 6 = HU12). Pick lists only show units inside the California-by-watersheds area. USGS froze WBD in January 2025 (3DHP is the successor).

areas.label: SMC region (Southern California Stormwater Monitoring Coalition)

source.method: Dissolve of the 19 SMC watersheds (SMC watershed set, May 2026)
source.internal_ref: smc-watersheds-2026 (location kept in the internal holdings file, not in this repo)

areas.status: SCCWRP boundary; decide whether to publish it as a public SCCWRP feature service or keep it internal
areas.notes: Santa Barbara Coast and the Channel Islands through Southern San Diego. An older single-polygon SMCRegion.shp (2018) also exists; compare before choosing.

areas.label: SMC watershed (one or more of 19)

source.internal_ref: smc-watersheds-2026 (location kept in the internal holdings file, not in this repo)

choices: Mission Bay and San Diego River
areas.notes: A Region 9 variant split by watershed management area also exists (SMC_Sheds_WMA_R9_v2.shp, 25 features).

areas.label: Regional Water Quality Control Board region
areas.notes: Polygon layer 1 (layer 0 is office points). Regions 1 to 9; Regions 5 and 6 have sub-offices, decide whether to expose those.

method: keep whole features that touch the area
options.buffer_km: optional distance added around the area (useful for coastal and cross-boundary work)
